title: orch scheduler ticket data: ext.scheduler
description: Owned by the scheduler add-on (its ticket_ext; the add-on ships a byte-identical copy). The core never reads it. One-time waits are core: waiting_on {kind: time, until}; the scheduler is one waker of those. Recurrence and launch policy live here.

recurring.description: true = run again and again by cron.

cron.description: 5-field cron (min hour day month weekday), always UTC, e.g. '0 7 * * 1'. Missed runs (machine off): one catch-up run, never several.

agent.description: Agent command name from [scheduler.agents] in .orch/config.toml. Default: [scheduler] agent.

last_run.description: Written by the scheduler after each run.
